newsitem.title: FINLAND: FORECAST-TT Tieto Q1 profit seen higher.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-TT Tieto Q1 profit seen higher.

text.p: A Reuter survey of analysts covering Finnish equities showed a 56 million markka median forecast for data service group TT Tieto Group Oy's first quarter profit after financial items, before extraordinaries.
The results are due on May 6 at 0900/0600 GMT.
In January-March last year, TT Tieto posted a 41.8 million markka profit before extraordinary items and tax.
TT Tieto said in February it expected group earnings to continue to develop favourably but gave no specific forecast.
The median of analysts' forecasts for TT-Tieto's full-year 1997 profit was for a 243 million markka (mean 245 million) and the range was 229-263 million markka.
TT Tieto's 1996 profit before extras was 194 million markka.
Contributors to the survey were: Aktia Bank, Carnegie Securities, Evli Securities,Merita, Opstock, Erik Selin and Postipankki.
